gen-luckiest-guy-gf-vend-sans: Vend Sans draws a ruler-straight line, its curves left unclosed at the ends and its x-height filling the row. But Luckiest Guy brings the shout, cheerful and poured-looking, so Vend Sans can simply do the talking underneath.
gen-vast-shadow-fs-epilogue: Vintage showpiece lettering: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to one width, while Epilogue loosens up with curvy, wire-thin monoline lowercase. Loud up top, friendly below, and nothing fights for attention.
gen-vast-shadow-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last. Under the vintage flourish of Vast Shadow, paragraphs would glide along smoothly, every bend giving the eye an unobstructed path.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-montserrat-alternates: Contemporary Montserrat Alternates tucks in beneath a vintage Vast Shadow heading. Its c curls open like a bent paperclip, and the chalk-board lowercase crowds up toward the capital line.
gen-vast-shadow-switzer: Switzer draws tubular, wire-like letters on a tall waist line, with c tips that never creep toward touching. And where Vast Shadow is best at turning heads, Switzer is best at staying out of the way.
gen-archivo-black-fs-recia: Recia has a light modulation you only notice up close. Archivo Black brings heavy urban authority, and Recia carries that confidence into finer strokes, so both voices sound equally sure.
gen-audiowide-gf-almendra: Futuristic tiles with wide grout lines: that's Audiowide. Almendra, dignified and bookish, takes over just below with a deep-bellied lowercase that makes long paragraphs feel like turning pages.
gen-comfortaa-gf-aleo: Neon-tube curves, friendly and geometric: Comfortaa stretches its wide ring of a c across the line. And Aleo settles in beneath it, dignified, with counters that let the eye slip in and out.
gen-comfortaa-gf-belgrano: Comfortaa is all neon-tube strokes and stretched spacing. Belgrano brings a classic, traditional voice below, its open-mouthed curves staying clear while the heading's t holds crossbar and stem at a single width.
gen-comfortaa-gf-biorhyme-expanded: BioRhyme Expanded opens wide gaps that break each word into single letters, its e clearly gapped. And with Comfortaa above, a full page of text would move slowly and deliberately, refined and bookish.
